title: Optimized + recalibrated pipeline over the expanded 27.66 h corpus
why: L3.01 (PR #148) showed the adopted optimizations shift the frozen-head score by +0.20 and break the verdict distribution (54% agreement). N5 (PR #156) refit both heads on sparse features and shipped configs/ensemble_v1_sparse.json + band [0.4193,0.6112]. The expanded corpus (manifest_scale_all.json: 9,757 windows / 391 clips / 85 factories / 27.66 h) now needs a full run with the recalibrated heads to measure throughput and the descriptive verdict distribution at the restored operating point.
hypothesis: The optimized + recalibrated pipeline runs over the expanded corpus at ~20 footage-h/wall-h (L3 rate) and produces a verdict distribution consistent with the frozen operating point, with no OOD regression.
data: queues/manifest_scale_all.json: 9,757 windows / 391 clips / 85 factories / 27.662 h, 1080p30 HEVC; label_source none (descriptive)
method: repo E8.01 pipeline + L3 runner (eval/exp_opt_scale/run_opt_scale.py); one NVDEC three-branch pass/window; pixel 3.33 fps, EG2 1 fps, 4 s early exit, skip mosaic, stride 1; heads configs/ensemble_v1_sparse.json; 6 workers, JADAL_GPU_SLOTS=4, OMP_NUM_THREADS=1; operating-point + determinism checks on 150 gold + 160 OOD

summary: PARTIAL (run still in flight): 830/9,757 windows (8.5%) scored, 0 errors, wall 1509 s, 0.55 win/s, 5.50 processed footage-h/wall-h; extrapolated full-corpus wall 296 min (4.9 h) for all 9,757 windows. Verdicts (descriptive): accept 210 (25.3%), reject 100 (12.0%), review 520 (62.7%); profiles factory_1080p30 827 / default 3. Per-stage p50/p95 ms: decode 7590/18101, descriptors 1403/4539, eg2_embed 464/1113, pixel_features 215/706, total 10003/23569. GPU util mean 12.4% p95 90%, VRAM mean 13.5 GiB max 16.9 GiB. Throughput ~3.5x below L3's uncontended 19.3 h/h because a peer transcode job saturated the network FS (decode p50 7.6 s vs L3 2.8 s). Operating point (independent re-apply of frozen vs recalibrated heads on N5 sparse features): gold review share 0.1867, confident BA 0.7632 (frozen heads) -> 0.9073 (recalibrated heads); OOD AUROC 0.6347 (frozen heads) -> 0.5231 (recalibrated), inside the frozen grouped CI. Determinism: 10 windows x 2 runs, content/features_digest/score-verdict 10/10 identical (raw receipt_sha256 varies only by latency_ms, by contract design).
decision: Keep the run in flight (background) and resume to completion; ship the recalibrated heads at the frozen operating point (no profile-threshold change needed). No OOD regression. Throughput blocked by external pod contention, not the pipeline.
cost: 6 workers on a shared A40; 1 NVDEC pass + 1 EG2 forward per window; ~2.1 GB RSS/worker
